mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id, p.cntrct_ty_cd, p.use_yn, p.cur_cntrct_amt FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT p.prj_id, p.cntrct_ty_cd, p.use_yn, p.cur_cntrct_amt FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.bill_stg_id, s.bill_stg_nm, s.sply_amt, s.bill_plan_dt, s.stg_odr_no, floor(s.sply_amt::numeric / 10)::bigint AS vat_amt, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id) AS billed FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY s.stg_odr_no
mapper.update: UPDATE prj.bill_stg SET stg_odr_no=#{ordinal} WHERE prj_id=#{projectId} AND bill_stg_id=#{stageId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM prj.bill_stg WHERE prj_id=#{projectId} AND bill_stg_id=#{stageId}
